acceptance_criteria.description: Matrix JSON validates with one row per task/case and explicit method columns for CMTBench, BiomniBench DA, NatureBench, BioML-Bench, and SWE-bench Lite probe.
Every matrix names its source snapshot, evaluator/result route, and limitations; raw answers, gold payloads, private paths, and credentials are excluded.
CMTBench matrix recomputes the MinionsOS task audit totals 18/50, 34/50, 28/50, 34/50, 16/50, 32/50, 16/50, and 36/50.
Run focused matrix validation, diff check, and repository import/ledger checks; record unrun checks explicitly.

objective: Add provenance-bound task-level matrix views for all currently cataloged benchmark cohorts so each task or case is one row and methods/configurations are compared horizontally, without exposing raw answers or changing existing ledger semantics.
title: Publish task-level benchmark matrices
